keySentence: Buck was suddenly taken from his safe home.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alaska was very cold and harsh. Buck had to learn new skills fast. He learned to sleep in the snow. Buck was suddenly taken from his safe home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Buck arrived in Alaska where everything was covered in snow and ice. The other sled dogs were rough and unfriendly toward him. Buck's food was stolen and he was pushed around constantly. But slowly, he learned to survive in this harsh new world. Buck was suddenly taken from his safe home. Buck refused to give up no matter how hard things became.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: The frozen wilderness of Alaska was nothing like Buck's warm California home. Temperatures dropped far below freezing, and the biting wind cut through his thick fur. The other sled dogs were tough, territorial, and showed Buck no mercy whatsoever. His food was stolen, and he had to fight just to keep his place in the pack. Buck was suddenly taken from his safe home. However, something remarkable began happening inside Buck as he faced these hardships. Because survival demanded it, he quickly learned to dig sleeping holes in the snow and guard his food. Each day, the comfortable house dog was transforming into something stronger, wilder, and more resilient.
